sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sections 1207-1208 — Glass and Glazing
sources.description: Governs minimum glass thickness, glazing area limits, safety glazing requirements, and allowable glass types by occupancy and location.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Section 1206 — Openings (Windows and Doors)
sources.description: Sets minimum and maximum window area requirements, ventilation area ratios, and fenestration standards.

sources.label: ASTM E1300 — Standard Practice for Determining Load Resistance of Glass in Buildings
sources.description: Industry standard for calculating glass thickness and load resistance under wind and impact loads. Referenced in Philippine practice.
